ev.q: record automatically which products a customer was buying at the till

1.why: B段。recording purchases at the till ↔ record … which products a customer was buying at the till。B shelf 也是超市里的地方，但原文说的是结账时。

ev.q: Thinking of the dots and dashes of Morse code, which he had learned as a boy scout

2.why: B段。a system of symbols ↔ the dots and dashes of Morse code；learned as a child ↔ learned as a boy scout。D colours 原文没有提到。

ev.q: the pair's first design arranged the lines in a series of circles, like a target

3.why: B段末句。readable from any angle ↔ read from any direction；round ↔ a series of circles。F square 是G段 QR 码的形状。

ev.q: in the early 1950s lasers had not yet been invented and computers filled entire rooms

4.why: C段。had not yet been invented ↔ lasers had not yet been invented；the equipment needed to read the code reliably simply did not exist。H tested 语法也通，但原文强调的是设备根本还不存在。

ev.q: The two inventors sold their patent to an electronics company for 15,000 dollars, a modest sum

5.why: C段。made little profit ↔ a modest sum … neither of them made a great deal of money from it。

ev.q: rectangular stripes could be printed more accurately than circles

6.why: D段。reproduced more accurately ↔ printed more accurately（印刷就是把图案复制到包装上）。L folded 原文没有提；不要误以为是“扫描”更准确，原文讲的是印刷时圆形会糊。

ev.q: The packet is now kept at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History in Washington.

7.why: E段。an object that has been preserved for display ↔ The packet is now kept at … Museum。

ev.q: shops now knew exactly which products had been sold, in what quantities and at what times, which allowed them to order new stock more precisely

8.why: F段。detailed sales information ↔ which products had been sold, in what quantities and at what times；helped shops ↔ order new stock more precisely … reduce the amount of space wasted。

ev.q: originally intended to track parts in car factories

9.why: G段。the original purpose of a later type of code ↔ QR code … originally intended to track parts in car factories。B段讲的是条形码最初的目的（结账记录），不是“后来的”码。

10.why: D段。More than one company ↔ Several companies；put forward a design ↔ submitted designs。最后入选的是 IBM 的 Laurer 方案，但题干只问是否有多家公司提交，所以是 TRUE。

ev.q: The new system did not spread quickly, however.

11.why: E段。题干说商店很快采用了新系统，原文直接说 did not spread quickly，直到1980年代初才普及，所以是 FALSE。

ev.q: Woodland was awarded the National Medal of Technology by the President of the United States

12.why: F段末句。eventually ↔ In 1992, forty years after receiving his patent；a national honour ↔ the National Medal of Technology。

ev.q: Yet the traditional barcode has survived, largely because it can be printed on almost any package at practically no cost.

13.why: G段只说 QR 码能存更多信息、传统条形码因便宜而保留下来，没有比较两者在超市里哪个用得更多。容易误选 FALSE（因为“条形码保留下来”），但原文并没有说条形码比 QR 码更常用。
